description: Users obtain artifacts across multiple sets of environments, e.g.: Production of a version of the bueld version from testing an environment and downloading the corresponding bueld version

option.name: Artifact Repository Address
option.help: The address of the repository, e.g. https://192.168.0:8443

option.name: Source Environment Path
option.help: Accessing version of the source environment path, e.g. MY-SYS/MY-MODULE/UAT

argument.name: Extract subdirectories
argument.help: Subdirectories extracted from release version directory, leave empty for all
